about: BOSS SIGNATURE MECHANICS (Dom 2026-10-28: each ring boss gets its own fighting identity). A MAP of mechanic id -> row; data/rings.json bosses[].mechanic names the id a boss wears (null = none), src/fight/mechanics/registry.ts maps the id to its code. Every number a mechanic uses is its row, validated in src/sim/validate.js (checkMechanics). Keep it a map: other bosses add their own id beside this one.

shadow-dash.about: KACHUJIN, ring 2. SHADOW DASH: the fast swordsman stops and an orange line draws on the sand from him to where you stand; the line LOCKS shortly before he goes, then he dashes along it (afterimages trail behind) and cuts. COUNTERS: step or roll OFF the line (the dash overshoots, no cut, he is open), or guard the cut. PUNISH: a recovery window after the dash, before his next move. A hit that staggers him cancels it. Distinct from the hero's Lunge special and from Nan's long polearm thrust: this is a body dash that stops at a cutting gap. Ticks are 60 Hz sim ticks, distances metres.
